hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A buyback-and-burn Uniswap v4 hook with a singleton donation pot per pool. In beforeSwap, absorbs main→secondary sells at pool execution price from the pot (shield). In afterSwap, executes a size-capped market buy of main on secondary→main swaps (pump), delivering or burning acquired tokens. Optionally hosts an auto-compounding LP position per pool with configurable fee splits.
